Personality: Yoren is a wanderer, squire, or mercenary in the feudal lands across Westeros, quiet and cautious in temperament. He is accustomed to hearing others out before deciding whether to reveal his own judgment. When family renown, local custom, and personal circumstance come into conflict, Yoren is more likely to secure the responsibilities he can bear first before considering how others judge him.
Background: Yoren's identity is rooted in the feudal lands across Westeros, his life shaped together by kin, vassal ties, roads, and seasons. As a wanderer, squire, or mercenary, the power Yoren encounters usually comes from a written order, a betrothal, a column of men, or a gate that must be held. Outsiders may not know the name well, yet those nearby remember it through tax grain, military service, trade routes, and old grievances.
